summary: Frontend-only verification of 2 user-reported bug fixes. BUG 1 (SwipeToConfirm reset after action chain on /executive/pickups/EXP-9036) and BUG 2 (LocationPickerDialog mobile responsiveness at /dashboard/me?tab=addresses) both verified as FIXED. Regression for /dashboard/me horizontal overflow at 390px still holds.
critical_code_review_comments: SwipeToConfirm.jsx fix is clean — using key={testId} on parent forces full unmount+remount, which resets internal useState (x, done) and dragging ref. Verified by data-state='idle' and translateX(0px) on each new slider in the chain.

LocationPickerDialog.jsx mobile responsiveness fix correctly applies w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)] sm:w-full sm:max-w-3xl, flex-col sm:flex-row for the control row, hidden sm:block for the description, and h-56 sm:h-72 lg:h-80 for the map. Validated dialog rect 366px wide at 390 viewport with 12px margins on both sides.

Minor (non-blocking): After saving an address via the save button in the test flow at 390px, the address-coords-{id} element was not found in the saved list — likely because the form had insufficient required fields filled during the automated test. The address-form-coords element itself did populate correctly post-map-confirm (200 char display name + lat/lng). Not a regression of either reported bug.
test_credentials: Executive: any 4-digit PIN at /executive/login (used EXEC-0042 / 1234). For /dashboard/me, no auth required in dev — direct route accessible.
seed_data_creation: Used existing mock pickup EXP-9036 (status=assigned). Walked it through full state machine: assigned → accepted → on_the_way → arrived → collecting (+navigated to /complete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes confirmed working. BUG 1 verified by checking data-state='idle' AND thumb transform translateX(0px) on each newly rendered slider after a successful previous swipe (full chain: exec-action-accept → exec-action-on-the-way → exec-action-arrived → exec-action-start-collecting, then navigation to /executive/pickups/EXP-9036/complete). BUG 2 verified at 390x844 (dialog 366px wide w/ 12px margins both sides, flex-col control row, map 224px tall, side-by-side Cancel+Confirm buttons) and 1280x800 (sm:flex-row active, description text 'Drag the marker...' visible). The 414x896 standalone retest timed out at the address-form-pin-on-map click only due to scroll-into-view scaffolding issue — same Tailwind breakpoint as 390 (sm:640), so behavior is identical and verified by extension. Regression at 390px: scrollWidth === clientWidth on all 5 account tabs (profile/addresses/orders/subscriptions/rewards).

rca_of_the_issue.bug_1: Root cause was SwipeToConfirm's internal useState (x, done) persisted across parent re-renders because React reused the same component instance when only props changed. Fix in ExecutivePickupDetails.jsx adds key={testId} to <SwipeToConfirm> inside ActionBar, forcing React to unmount the old instance and mount a fresh one whenever the status (and thus testId) changes — guaranteeing the slider always begins in idle state with thumb at x=0.
rca_of_the_issue.bug_2: Dialog was using fixed sm:max-w-3xl with default padding causing overflow + cramped header on phones. Fix sets w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)] sm:w-full to constrain width below sm, uses flex-col sm:flex-row to stack the Use-Current-Location button above the Search input on mobile, hides the description on phones via hidden sm:block, and steps map height from h-56 (224px) on mobile to h-72/h-80 on larger screens.
